title: Marine casualty state becomes dangerous when watertight integrity, stability, navigation, bridge/team state, and evacuation/investigation rails diverge
summary: Candidate pattern: marine casualties become more legible when vessel state is factored into watertight integrity, stability/damage condition, bridge/navigation state, propulsion/engineering state, evacuation and survivability, and investigation/correction rails. Viking Sky is included as a near-miss control so the pattern does not learn only from fatal losses.

status_history.note: Created with four casualty records, one near-miss control, and four infrastructure rails; no maturity claims allowed.

place.scope: marine casualty state, watertight/stability/evacuation legibility, and correction rails

subjects.name: marine casualty state divergence and investigation/correction rail

claims.claim: The promoted rev0028 marine records support a candidate pattern in which vessel danger becomes hard to control when watertight integrity, stability/damage state, navigation/bridge state, propulsion/engineering state, evacuation state, and investigation/correction rails diverge.
what_would_change_status: A second-pass source review materially revises the extraction, narrows its scope, or adds a stronger primary source.

evidence_profile.source_depth: one-pass official investigation / official rail extraction, with Costa source treated as an official investigative-body presentation/report mirror needing second-pass provenance check
limitations: No denominator of all marine casualties or vessel classes.
No direct comparison yet with aviation/rail CRM or structural evacuation records.

positive_controls_needed: Add a passenger-vessel casualty or near-miss where watertight integrity, stability calculation, bridge state, and evacuation rails worked as intended and limited harm.
Add a controlled-success record after SOLAS/ro-ro or safety-management reforms to test correction infusion.
negative_controls_needed: Add a marine casualty where watertight/stability/evacuation state was legible and not explanatory, to prevent overfitting.
Add a non-passenger cargo casualty where pattern axes are present but not causally dominant.
counterexamples_to_seek: Cases where vessel state was severe but evacuation and damage-control surfaces were sufficient.
Cases where the main causal grain is external hazard or structural failure rather than state-legibility/evacuation divergence.
Cases where investigation rails existed but public learning was blocked by jurisdiction, language, litigation, or proprietary records.
rollback_triggers: Second-pass report extraction materially weakens one of the new support records.
The pattern conflates ro-ro watertight integrity with general marine casualty risk too broadly.
A control set shows this should split into ro-ro vehicle-deck flooding, bridge resource management, damage-stability, and evacuation/muster patterns.
The pattern is upgraded only after controls and not by record count alone.

maturity_gate.minimum_before_mature: At least two near-miss/controlled-success controls, at least one negative control, at least one recommendation/code-closure record, and one vessel-class contrast outside ro-ro/passenger cases.

handling_notes: Marine-casualty records must preserve the dignity of passengers, crew, families, responders, and survivors.
Do not collapse safety-investigation causal language into individual blame; separate safety investigation, legal liability, vessel operation, design, maintenance, and emergency-response surfaces.
This is historical/evidentiary infrastructure, not operational navigation, stability, damage-control, legal, regulatory, or emergency guidance.

unknowns: No full recommendation-closure or rulemaking history encoded yet.
No denominator of marine casualties by vessel class, flag state, or regulatory regime.
Costa Concordia source is a mirrored official investigative-body presentation/report and needs second-pass provenance hardening.
next_actions: Second-pass extract full reports for Herald, Estonia, Costa Concordia, El Faro, and Viking Sky.
Create recommendation/code-closure child records for SOLAS ro-ro changes, muster/evacuation reforms, BRM/SMS guidance, and survival-craft requirements.
